section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: SWI OS_SetEnv has been modified to remove the undocumented register modification which was provided for compatibility with Brazil systems. Registers R2 and R3 no longer return the amount of memory in the machine and the Brazil buffering information (respectively). These will be preserved.
